comparison.objective: Diagnose a leaking cable core using a hand-crank insulation tester and mark it.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuously crank with one hand while positioning a probe sequentially with the other, then act on the reading.
comparison.success_condition: All three cores tested for 1 s at sufficient crank speed, only faulty flag marked, probe returned, hands clear, stable 1 s.
comparison.reason: Bimanual temporal coordination is generic; diagnosis by cranking and probing does not test impact delivery, fracture, insert retention, or fragment containment.
